# #761 — pre-push hook tests the working tree, not the pushed tip: a clean docs-only branch cannot be pushed from a dirty checkout

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-26T00:52:58Z
Updated: 2026-08-26T00:52:58Z

---

## What happened

Pushing `fix/757-agents-embedder-host` (`75ea217`, one docs-only commit on `origin/main`: `AGENTS.md` 2 lines) from the dev checkout was refused by `_githooks/pre-push`. The hook's `bun test` (line 493) ran against the WORKING TREE, which is `sprint/standards-fmt` with the held #750 sprint's uncommitted lint edits (`server/observability/langfuse-tracing.ts` among 30 dirty files), plus the unlanded #744/#747 commits. Failures in the log (`_scratch/pre-push/bun-test-75363-1787705436.log`): `makeMemoryDistillHandler` null-namespace sweep, context-pack `requested_sections`, and the `langfuse-tracing` suite. None of that is in the pushed commit; `origin/main` + the commit is `AGENTS.md` only.

## Why it is a hook defect, not a branch problem

- `resolve_base` / `classify` (lines ~200-280) carefully diff `<base>..<tip>` so the gate judges "the thing in hand" (the hook's own words at line 164, the #705-#714 family). `bun test` at line 493 then ignores that and tests whatever is checked out and dirty.
- Result: a clean docs-only branch cannot be pushed from any checkout whose working tree is dirty or on another branch. The #750 session hit the identical wall on 2026-08-25 (its handoff records `git push` refused by pre-push on `sprint/standards-enforcement`).
- Agents get no override (line 371), and `--no-verify` is forbidden by `_DOCS/STANDARDS-git.md`, so the only exits are a human bypass or a second checkout, which the HANDOFF-BASE forbids (no worktrees).

## What a fix looks like (PROPOSED)

Run the test step against the pushed tip (export `PUSH_LOCAL_SHA` into a temp checkout under `{temp_workspace}/open-brain/_validation-runs/`, or `git stash`-free `git worktree`-free `git archive | tar` into scratch), or skip `bun test` when `git diff --name-only <base> <tip>` touches no code path, announced per "nothing is adjusted silently". Either keeps the gate on the thing in hand.
